headline: Bank of Tanzania to Regulate Zanzibar’s Non-Deposit-Taking Microfinance Providers
summary: The Bank of Tanzania will regulate and supervise non-deposit-taking microfinance providers in Zanzibar, previously licensed by the Ministry of Finance. Existing providers must apply by 31 December 2026.
why: Microfinance providers extend small loans to households and businesses; central-bank oversight sets capital and governance standards for the sector.
